text:
Wiesbaden’s median asking rent stands at 14.0 €/m² in June 2026, with a year‑on‑year rise of 5.3 % and a five‑year gain of 24.1 %. The city ranks 10th among the 37 most expensive German markets, while the 25th‑percentile level is 12.2 €/m² and the 75th‑percentile 16.17 €/m².

The market remains balanced but tight: listings spend an average of 27 days on the market and 26 % are let within a week. Vacancy is low at 2.0 % and rent burden for a two‑person household is 14.9 % on a 60 m² unit costing €840 per month. Asking rents sit 52 % above the 2022 existing‑rent benchmark of €9.21 €/m².

The model forecast for the next 12 months projects median asking rents of 14.77 €/m², ranging from 14.35 €/m² to 15.06 €/m², implying a further 5.5 % increase.
